item.title: Demo
item.description:
Basic usage

Include CSS and JS


<link rel="stylesheet" href="jumpyscroll.css">
<script src="jumpyscroll.min.js"></script>

HTML


<body>
    <section>
        This is a first section!
    </section>
    <section>
        ...
    </section>
</body>

JS

$(document).ready(function() {  
    window.jumpyScroll();  
});

Next: options usage

Options usage

JS

$(document).ready(function() {  
    window.jumpyScroll({
        speed: 1500,
        animation: 'jello'
    });  
});

Next: custom buttons

Custom buttons

CSS

.jumpyscroll.nav {
    justify-content: flex-end;
    align-items: center;
    width: 100%;
}

.jumpyscroll.nav .prev {
    display: none;
}

.jumpyscroll.nav .next {
    background-image: none;
    width: auto;
    line-height: 2.5rem;
    height: auto;
    color: white;
    font-size: 1rem;
    margin: 0.5rem;
    padding: 0 2rem;
}

JS

$(document).ready(function() {  
    window.jumpyScroll({
        info: false,
        dots: false,
        nextLabel: 'Continue',
    });  
});

See the demo

Next: FontAwesome using

Using FontAwesome

CSS

.jumpyscroll.nav .prev {
    background-image: none;
    display: flex;
}

.jumpyscroll.nav .next {
    background-image: none;
    display: flex;
}

.jumpyscroll.nav .next i, .jumpyscroll.nav .prev i {
    margin: auto;
}

.jumpyscroll .dot {
    cursor: pointer;
    background-image: none;
    opacity: 0.5;
}

.jumpyscroll .dot.active {
    opacity: 1;
}

JS

$(document).ready(function() {  
    window.jumpyScroll({
        prevLabel: '<i class="fa fa-chevron-up"></i>',
        nextLabel: '<i class="fa fa-chevron-down"></i>',
        dotLabel: '<i class="fa fa-circle"></i>',
    });  
});

See the demo

Next: dots with numbers

Dots with numbers

CSS

.jumpyscroll .dots {
    counter-reset: dn;
}

.jumpyscroll .dot {
    width: 2em;
    height: 2em;
    background-image: none;
    background-color: white;
}

.jumpyscroll .dots div {
    margin: auto;
}

.jumpyscroll .dot div:before {
    content: counter(dn);
    counter-increment: dn;
    color: black;
    font-weight: 900;
}

JS

$(document).ready(function() {  
    window.jumpyScroll({  
        dotLabel: '<div></div>',
    });  
});

See the demo

Next: custom animation

Custom animation

CSS

@-webkit-keyframes ufo {
  from {
    transform: scale3d(0, 0, 0) translate3d(500px, -500px, 0px);
  }
}
 
@keyframes ufo {
    from {
        transform: scale3d(0, 0, 0) translate3d(500px, -500px, 0px);
    }
}

.ufo {
  -webkit-animation-name: ufo;
  animation-name: ufo;
  -webkit-animation-timing-function: cubic-bezier(1,.38,.3,1.01);
  animation-timing-function: cubic-bezier(1,.38,.3,1.01);
}

JS

$(document).ready(function() {  
    window.jumpyScroll({
        animation: 'ufo',
        speed: 1500,
    });  
});

See the demo

Next: events

Events

JS

window.jumpyScroll({
    onAfterScroll: function(index) {
        switch (index) {
            case 0:
                jumpyScroll.settings.infoText = 'This is first page!';
                break;
            case 1:
                post('seekTo', 54);
                post('play');
                break;
        }
    },
    onBeforeScroll: function(index) {
        switch (index) {
            default:
                post('pause');
                jumpyScroll.settings.infoText = 'Page ${pageNo} from ${pageCount}';
                break;
        }
    }
});

See the demo
